We talk about growing up in Nukeville, the risk of AI and China, and how AI is actually creating jobs.

congrats to @elonmusk @ibab @jimmybajimmyba @Yuhu_ai_

urls.description: EnigmaEval is a benchmark from puzzle hunts, testing AI with complex reasoning, creative problem-solving, and cross-domain knowledge synthesis.
urls.title: EnigmaEval

data.text:
Site: https://t.co/fHr6M76O3E
Paper: https://t.co/lWjW3AvFyg

We started by evaluating all top models with:
* multi-modal capabilities
* released via API

We will of course be adding new models as they become available (o3-mini, o3-mini-high, o3, deepseek-r1, etc.).

The frontier of AI reasoning is wide open. Let’s push it.

This was only possible thanks to an incredibly brilliant group of puzzle writers and game masters who have created these puzzles over many years.

If you're interested, give some of these puzzles a try! https://t.co/zCc9vDKfS7
Here you can see some sample puzzles: https://t.co/hKX9zXpp5X

On the heels of Humanity's Last Exam, @scale_AI & @cais have released a new very-hard reasoning eval:

EnigmaEval: 1,184 multimodal puzzles so hard they take groups of humans many hours to days to solve.

All top models score 0 on the Hard set, and <10% on the Normal set

🧵 https://t.co/BMik0I9YaS
@paulg 🫡

I remember this conversation quite well.

We spoke about organization design innovation, a deep dive into the early days of Microsoft, your company as your life’s work, and British teas.

(some of this may have been overflow to the 2nd conversation) https://t.co/8tJRZQT5Kj

Jessica Livingston interviewed me for YC in 2016 for 15 minutes.

8 years later, she reveals her interview notes and the notes from our batch.

Along the way, we discuss MEI, the death and rebirth of meritocracy in Silicon Valley, and the art of culture.

https://t.co/Zol2rTITbd https://t.co/gXR52pqPrD

Free nations must lead in AI.

Good conversation with @Keir_Starmer on global AI standards, economic prosperity, and how we can partner on the immense AI opportunities in the UK. https://t.co/Zo801DxnWg

Historic speech from @VP at the Paris Al Action Summit.

The speech rang through the Al world.

Clarity, strength, and no nonsense from VP Vance to deliver American Al Leadership. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/ihI6zl57nU
@JasonMiller @scale_AI @foxandfriends @realDonaldTrump 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸
Great to meet @narendramodi and @EmmanuelMacron in Paris today! https://t.co/l5pLBeHNcA
@loganbartlett @TheoVon gotta keep em guessing
coming soon to a podcast app near you @TheoVon https://t.co/1SL6YS2Ruo
🙋‍♂️ good company https://t.co/YI4JK3qGqP

urls.description: MultiChallenge evaluates frontier LLMs on realistic multi-turn conversations, assessing instruction retention, inference memory, and self-coherence.
urls.title: MultiChallenge

data.text:
Introducing MultiChallenge by @scale_AI - a new multi-turn conversation benchmark.

Current frontier LLMs score under 50% accuracy (top: 44.93%).

🥇o1
🥈Claude 3.5 Sonnet
🥉Gemini 2.0 Pro Experimental

📄 Paper: https://t.co/Z5OFus2hFe
🏆Leaderboard: https://t.co/fIis8SwqpJ https://t.co/4ZXgjAklKa

Congrats to OpenAI on getting 26.6 on HLE with deep research!

We look forward to evaling OpenAI deep research on the Humanity Last Exam private set soon! https://t.co/8VPDfPLOwu
o3-mini and o3-mini-high results are slightly better on Humanity’s Last Exam, but still <15% https://t.co/TP8DLvzTmj
